title: Senior HR Operations Specialist
description:
**Join CellPoint Digital: Shape the Future of Payments with Us!**




 At CellPoint Digital, we’re revolutionizing the way businesses in the air, travel, and hospitality sectors manage their payments. 
   





 With our
 **Leading Payment Orchestration Platform** 
 , we’re turning payments into a strategic advantage, helping clients optimize their payment experience to boost profits, maximize approvals, lower costs and take control of their payment, resulting in more money to the bottom line.
 







 We believe payments should be a
 **strategic asset** 
 , delivering financial, customer, and operational value. Our vision is to unify the payment ecosystem, opening up a world of opportunities for leading brands in the air, travel, and hospitality industries. We transform the payment supply chain from a cost center into a
 **profit engine** 
 , turning every transaction into an opportunity for growth and competitive advantage.
 







 At our core,
 **we're innovators** 
 and
 **problem\-solvers** 
 united by five key values: Mission First, Ownership, Trust \& Transparency, Driven, and One Team. We're ambitious professionals who embrace accountability and transform payments together.
 







 Our diverse community spans the globe, with hubs in Copenhagen, Dallas, Dubai, London, Miami, Pune, Buenos Aires, Bogota, Mexico, and Singapore, along with remote team members worldwide. We celebrate the unique perspectives and experiences that make our team extraordinary.
 







 Join us as an
 **Senior HR Operation Specialist** 
 on our mission to turn payments into possibilities!
 







**Senior HR Operation Specialist** 








 We are currently seeking a full\-time
 **Senior HR Operations Specialist** 
 to join our team in Pune. This role serves as the backbone of the HR function, ensuring seamless execution of our core HR processes across the employee lifecycle, globally. 
   





 This role is responsible for managing HR systems, maintaining data integrity, and delivering consistent and efficient employee experiences across geographies. Acting as the first point of contact for HR\-related queries, this role will closely work with the Lead HR Business Partner to enable smooth delivery of HR initiatives, providing critical operational and logistical support across areas such as performance, engagement and culture. 
 



  

**How You Will Make an Impact:** 








**HR Systems and Data Management:** 



* Own and manage HR systems (Deel and other platforms), ensuring employee records and documentation are in line with internal policies and local compliance requirements
* Maintain and update employee data, organisational structures, and reporting lines
* Draft and issue employment documents including contracts, HR letters, and contractual amendments
* Manage the operational aspects of the onboarding and offboarding process including conducting background checks, HR documentations compilation, system set up and exit processes
* Track and manage the global visa, right\-to\-work, compliance documentation, proactively flagging expirations or issues to the Head of HR



**Employee Relations:** 



* Act as the first point of contact for all global HR\-related queries regarding employment, benefits, and operations, ensuring timely and effective resolution
* Provide guidance on policies, processes and systems
* Coordinate formal meetings for employee relations cases, document notes, and independently prepare the standard ER correspondence
* Maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive employee data with professionalism
* Escalate complex matters to relevant stakeholders and the Head of HR where required



**Policy and Compliance:** 



* Maintain and update HR policies and the global employee handbook in line with company standards
* Ensure compliance through regular audits of employee records and HR processes



**HR Initiatives and Projects:** 



* Partner closely with the Lead HR Business Partner to provide operational and logistical support for initiatives related to performance management, engagement and workshops including tracking completion rates, scheduling sessions etc.
* Generate reports and create dashboards to support the HR team and business with decision\-making
* Liaise with Legal, Finance and IT to ensure seamless operational execution across the employee lifecycle
* Continuously streamline and automate processes and use AI where possible



**Skills you will have fine\-tuned:** 



* Masters degree or a PG Diploma  in Human Resource Management
* Minimum of 4 years of experience in HR operations, administration or HR shared services
* Familiarity with global HR systems and tools (eg. Deel or a similar platform)
* High attention to detail and and strong organisational skills
* Ability to manage multiple priorities across geographies
* HR certification such as SHRM would be a plus
* You are eager to bring your unique talents and authenticity to the CellPoint Digital community.
* You're constantly curious and a lifetime learner.
* You have excellent communication and relationship\-building skills.
* You enjoy leading and supporting cross\-functional initiatives and projects in a team where you are empowered and accountable.
* You thrive in a fast\-paced environment and the challenge of managing multiple projects simultaneously while prioritizing high\-return work.
* You approach challenges with a solution\-oriented mindset.







**What's in it for you:** 



* We offer you the opportunity to be an innovator, challenge the status quo, and redefine the payments category
* Competitive salary in a fast\-growing start\-up
* Medical insurance with coverage for dependents (parents, spouse, children)
* Rewards and recognition system
* Opportunity for personal and professional growth in a dynamic industry







 What makes CellPoint Digital a leader in the payment landscape isn’t just our technology \- it’s our people and how we work together. We’ve built a global community where diverse talents and perspectives unite to create innovative solutions. 
 







 When you join us, you become part of something bigger: a collaborative culture that crosses borders and disciplines, bringing out the best in every team member to deliver breakthrough results for our clients and partners.  
 







 Together, we are transforming the payments industry \- challenging, supporting, and inspiring one another in the process.
 







 Please note, we retain applicant data for 12 months for recruitment purposes and future opportunities, after which it is securely deleted. At CellPoint Digital we are committed to be globally compliant with robust data protection.

 Job Description
 
  

**Role**

 ͏
 
**Do** 




 \- Delivery Management
   

 \- Ensure seamless delivery of the projects 
   

 \- Deploy optimum project delivery structure post transition/ migration phase by evaluating the budget, costs, risks and staffing requirement 
   

 \- Create quarterly project charter with well\-defined weekly project trajectory as per the project specifications \& requirements and ensure 100% adherence in terms of schedule, quality, efforts and costs 
 



  

 \- Ensure 100% compliance to Project SLAs, information security protocols and etc (all customers contractual obligations)
   

 \- Monitor and take appropriate actions on internal and external audit findings to ensure no major non\-compliance/ deviation from the SLA

 \- Conduct periodic cadence with the quality team to take proactive measures to resolves issues/ possible escalations

 \- Regularly audit quality (QA) status of delivery and engage QA team to ensure adherence to Quality Assurance standards and processes
   

 \- Maintain project structure in Confluence \& SAP in line with prevailing business requirements and norms
   

 \- Ensure expected ramp down (ERD) compliance as committed in MSA

 \- Identify and close early warnings on a project to avoid any customer escalations
   

 \- Plan and conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR) along with DMs/ ADH with the client management/ leadership team to drive improvement actions and mine for a new portfolio/ opportunity within the account
   

 \- Design and monitor project performance dashboards/ reports with the clients periodically
 



 \- Delivery governance across the project
   

 \- Create weekly/ monthly/ quarterly MIS and reports to monitor and track overall project
   

 \- Conduct periodic reviews with the delivery team on operational, quality and fulfillment parameters and new idea generation \& its implementation on existing projects
 



 \- Identify and resolve potential risks or early warning signs on project delivery to drive for ZERO surprise escalations and eliminate any revenue leakage

 \- Review and monitor revenue allocations/ realization to avoid OB revenue leakage

 ͏

 \- Automation Focus
   

 \- Perform pareto analysis as per the no. of incidents received and accordingly identify automation opportunities and drive value adds across the project
   

 \- Deploy next generation hyper automation and crowdsourcing initiatives in coordination with Holmes RO team to enhance productivity, quality and speed of delivery
 



  

 \- Interact and engage with tools team to bring in new tools in the project to automate certain pointers/ elimination of any noise in the project
 



 \- Innovation Focus
   

 \- Brainstorm with the team to identify improvement opportunities and initiatives to further improve quality, delivery speed and productivity parameters
   

 \- Drive value adds and BVMs; ensure management showcases them to customer in MRM \& QBR to drive growth
 



 \- Plan and conduct periodic idea campaigns to generate new solutions to the problems/ define better ways of working
 



 \- Drive and deploy Knowledge Management and sharing 
   

 \- Contribute in internal knowledge sharing initiatives at Wipro by driving internal training sessions, best practices, learnings, value adds and BVMs and deploys best practices in various projects within own account
   

 \- Deploy the Wipro's knowledge management portal across the account and monitor \& track trainings
 



 \- Capability Development and Talent Pipeline Creation
   

 \- Demand forecasting in line with business requirements 
   

 \- Anticipate attrition and ensure right talent supply chain to deliver the project
   

 \- Spearhead quarterly demand forecasting and resource planning aligned to project requirements
 



  

 \- Create and deploy a workplan to fulfil the required demand from all the talent channels including external (lateral, contractors etc) hiring in coordination with WMG/ CWMG and Talent Acquisition team
   

 \- Anticipate new skills/ upcoming technologies required to deliver the project and ensure the team is trained or right talent is inducted into the project as per the skill requirements
 



 \- Drive 100% compliance on trainings and upskilling requirements 
   

 \- Prioritize and identify essential and upcoming technical skills required across programs/ projects to facilitate and drive right supply chain
   

 \- Drive towards 100% mandatory training compliance for the target population within an account
 



 \- Plan and drive rotations for seed positions and ensure replacement plan to be arrived ahead of rotations
   

 \- Quarterly connect with critical talent to understand their career aspirations and create their learning maps along with project managers and HRBP
 



 \- Fresher engagement program
   

 \- Ensure a stable arrangement and assimilation of rookie within accounts in coordination with competency group team (classroom trainings/ e\-learning, certifications, on the job training etc)
 



 \- Team Management
   

 \- Resourcing
   

 \- Forecast talent requirements as per the current and future business needs
   

 \- Hire adequate and right resources for the team
 



 \- Talent Management
   

 \- Ensure adequate onboarding and training for the team members to enhance capability \& effectiveness
   

 \- Build an internal talent pool and ensure their career progression within the organization
 



  

 \- Manage team attrition
   

 \- Drive diversity in leadership positions
   

 \- Performance Management
   

 \- Set goals for the team, conduct timely performance reviews and provide constructive feedback to own direct reports
   

 \- Ensure that the Performance Nxt is followed for the entire team
 



 \- Employee Satisfaction and Engagement
   

 \- Lead and drive engagement initiatives for the team
   

 \- Track team satisfaction scores and identify initiatives to build engagement within the team
 



 \- Facilitate rewards and recognition to acknowledge the high performers in the team
   

  
 


 ͏
 
 Deliver
 



  
   

 1\.
   

  
   

 Delivery Management ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢Â‚Â¬Ã¢Â€Âœ Client satisfaction
   

  
   

 PCSAT, Brand score, no. of customer references, SDR/ QBR %, Pulse % satisfied (top 2 box), Zero surprise delivery escalation from the customer, adherence to project charter
   

  
   

 2\.
   

  
   

 Delivery Management ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢Â‚Â¬Ã¢Â€Âœ operational efficiency
   

  
   

 Contractual adherence %, Quality index, Utilization %, cost of delivery target, overdue indent, 100% SLA compliance, PEI % target, 100% usage of click to bill, % SAP loss for T\&M projects
   

  
   

 3\.

 Revenue target achievement, Operating margin %, leakage from OB to revenue, revenue per employee, CR realization target, process exceptions to be minimized, bench cost % of total cost, underrun % target for FPP projects, effort saving through NG\-1, NG\-2 initiatives

 % attrition, critical talent attrition%, % trained on new age skills, % of team trained in necessary behavioural skills, diversity ratio, % localization targets by market, billable rookie ratio, rookie/NJNB assimilation TATs, offshore mix

 Team attrition %, Employee satisfaction score

title: Internal Audit-Hyderabad-Analyst-Business Audit
description:
**Job Description**
 Internal Audit – Bengaluru – Analyst\- Enterprise Audit
   

  

 The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. is a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm that provides a wide range of financial services to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments, and individuals. Founded in 1869, the firm is headquartered in New York and maintains offices in all major financial centers around the world. We commit people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Our people are our greatest asset – we say it often and with good reason. It is only with the determination and dedication of our people that we can serve our clients, generate long\-term value for our shareholders and contribute to the broader public. We take pride in supporting each colleague both professionally and personally. From collaborative workspaces and ergonomic services to well\-being and resilience offerings, we offer our people the flexibility and support they need to reach their goals in and outside the office
   

  

 INTERNAL AUDIT
   

  

 In Internal Audit, we ensure that Goldman Sachs maintains effective controls by assessing the reliability of financial reports, monitoring the firm’s compliance with laws and regulations, and advising management on developing smart control solutions. Our group has unique insight on the financial industry and its products and operations. We’re looking for detail\-oriented team players who have an interest in financial markets and want to gain insight into the firm’s operations and control processes.
   

  

**What We Look For**
 Goldman Sachs Internal Auditors demonstrate strong risk and control mindsets, analytical, exercise professional skepticism and are able to challenge and discuss effectively with management on risks and control measures. We look for individuals who enjoy learning about audit, businesses and functions, have innovative and creative mindsets to adopt analytical techniques to enhance audit techniques, building relationships and are able to evolve and thrive in teamwork and in a fast\-paced global environment.
   

  

 YOUR IMPACT
   

  

 As The Third Line Of Defense, Internal Audit’s Mission Is To Independently Assess The Firm’s Internal Control Structure, Including The Firm’s Governance Processes And Controls, And Risk Management And Capital And Anti\-financial Crime Frameworks, Raise Awareness Of Control Risk And Monitor The Implementation Of Management’s Control Measures. In Doing So, Internal Audit
   

  

* Communicates and reports on the effectiveness of the firm’s governance, risk management and controls that mitigate current and evolving risk
* Raise awareness of control risk
* Assesses the firm’s control culture and conduct risks
* Monitors management’s implementation of control measures


 Goldman Sachs Internal Audit comprises individuals from diverse backgrounds including chartered accountants, developers, risk management professionals, cybersecurity professionals, and data scientists. We are organized into global teams comprising business and technology auditors to cover all the firm’s businesses and functions, including securities, investment banking, consumer and investment management, risk management, finance, cyber\-security and technology risk, and engineering.
   

  

 This position description is intended to describe the duties most frequently performed by an individual in this position. It is not intended to be a complete list of assigned duties but to describe a position level. The
   

  

 role shall be performed within a professional office environment. Goldman Sachs has health and safety polices that are available for all workers upon request. There are no specific health risks associate with the
   

  

 role.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 As an Sr Analyst/Associate, you will be responsible for execution of audit deliverables through effective time management, in accordance with the internal audit methodology of the department. You will assist the project manager in planning the scope of the audit, conduct walkthroughs and discussions with various teams to execute the audit scope and discuss results of the audit with the firms local and global management. You will play a vital role in execution of the audit scope, through succinct documentation and active engagement with various stakeholders focusing on analyzing the risks involved, assessing the design and operating effectiveness of the key controls implemented to mitigate the risk, in accordance with the internal audit methodology of the department. In addition, you will also monitor and follow up with management on the resolution of the open audit findings and maintain stakeholder relationship to monitor risk in their space. Job responsibilities also include assisting in the department’s continuous monitoring effort to cover operations incidents, market and regulatory events, business and technology updates. You are strongly encouraged to participate in department\-wide initiatives aimed at continually improving IA's processes and supporting infrastructure.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Chartered Accountant /Certified Financial Analyst /Masters in Business Administration specialized in Finance / Masters or equivalent University degrees in Accounting / Finance.
* CA fresher or 1 years of experience in risk\-based operations / process audits preferably focusing on areas such as human resources, accounts payable, procurement, third party risk management, and/or payment functions.
* Experience in executing audit engagements, with good judgement of risks and controls
* Strong technical skills required for the role with attention to detail, strong analytical skills and ability to translate the assimilated knowledge through effective documentation
* Experience in working in a team environment and adaptable to differential ways of working
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, interpersonal skills, as the job requires frequent interaction with cross functional teams and stakeholders across the hierarchy within management
* Highly motivated with the ability to multi\-task and remain organized in a fast\-paced environment


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with data analytics tools and techniques
* Relevant certification or industry accreditation
* Capable of developing or implementing efficiency improvement or automated solutions that assist audit work

 The WLAN Performance Test Engineer is responsible for validating the throughput, latency, RF performance of Wi\-Fi products and Power efficiency under various real\-world and lab conditions. The role ensures compliance with IEEE 802\.11 standards and identifies performance bottlenecks at PHY/MAC layers.

* Validate performance under high client density scenarios.
* Simulate concurrent traffic (VoIP, video streaming, web traffic).

 Since Ouro's founding in 1999 by industry pioneers, Ouro products have processed billions of dollars in transaction volume and served millions of customers worldwide. The company is headquartered in Austin, Texas with employees worldwide.

 As a Senior Network Engineer, you will be responsible for the architecture, deployment, and optimization of our global, high\-availability network infrastructure across data centers and AWS cloud environments. Your role involves expert\-level knowledge in managing complex enterprise routing and switching, designing and maintaining enterprise Wireless Infrastructure (Cisco Meraki), configuring enterprise\-grade firewalls (e.g., Palo Alto), and integrating hybrid cloud solutions. You will bridge the gap between high\-level business goals and technical execution, ensuring our network is cost\-optimized, secure by design, and resilient.

* Bachelor’s Degree and 7\+ years of experience in Network Engineering
* Expert\-level knowledge in designing and maintaining scalable, high\-availability network solutions across global data centers and AWS cloud environments.

* Proficiency in managing complex enterprise routing and switching
* Proven experience in designing, deploying, and optimizing enterprise Wireless Technologies.

+ Oversee server room environmental monitoring, power distribution (PDU), and UPS systems.
+ Maintain data center technologies such as VXLAN, EVPN, or Cisco ACI.

* Basic understanding of DITA/XML
* Have an understanding of technical certification methods for global audiences.
* Must be flexible and possess outstanding decision‐making skills.
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills; ability to work cross\-functionally, maintain, and regularly update multiple project schedules.
* Must be a quick learner, self‐starter, and have the ability to work with minimal supervision in a fast‐paced, high‐tech environment.


**TOOL KNOWLEDGE**
* MS Word
* DITA/XML
* Adobe FrameMaker
* ArbotText Editor
* SnagIT
* MS PowerPoint


**Shift time\-** 
 General shift

title: Global MD Executive Talent Senior Manager
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 To be the best partner for driving lasting change with our clients, BCG invests in, develops, and partners with specialty businesses to deepen our expertise, broaden our capabilities, and support our clients with what they need to win. The most senior leaders in these businesses are Managing Directors (MDs), and we are looking for a talented HR professional to drive the MD Executive Talent function in Asia Pacific.
   

  

 In this role, you will contribute to the best\-in\-class Executive Talent services provided to our specialty Managing Directors across AP. You will be partnering with a variety of senior leaders across BCG and Specialty businesses in driving an enhanced value proposition for our MDs. It also requires to design and drive processes and services that contribute to the development of their careers and learning, as well as deliver first class hiring, contracting and compensation services that meet HR Executive Talent standards. Both the rigorous management of the related information (including the most sensitive) and of very diverse stakeholders are key success factors in this role.
   

  

 As an HR BP, you will be responsible, including but not limited to:
   

  

* Be a trusted and credible partner representing the MD model. Own, facilitate, and provide senior level support for the career development and performance processes for our Managing Directors, and ensure that our MD Career Development Committees (MDDCs) run smoothly and deliver robust career development, rewards, and recognition for our executives
* Lead and play key decision support role in MD life cycle events (lateral hires, onboarding, promotions, transfers, departures, and terminations), driving consistency with global norms. Ensure timely and comprehensive expert involvement and alignment with local and regional HR and Legal teams, global Centers of Excellence, and specialty business leadership
* Working closely with Global Compensation and Finance teams. Play a key role in the annual planning cycle, including MD target setting, tracking, analysis and measurement
* Contribute to the evolution of MD career framework and learning \& development offerings. Partner with senior leaders on promotion decisions, talent pipeline, and tailored solutions for executive development needs
* Proactively suggest, and autonomously implement ongoing improvements to experience, quality, and level of support delivered through our processes, as well as information and knowledge management
* Act as point of contact for all MD queries related to employee relations, career development, compensation and change programs
* Support relevant change initiatives to enhance our MD value proposition


 Additionally, you will support the evolution of our processes, policies and tools, for example:
   

  

* processes and practices for onboarding new MDs, training Career Advisors, MD L\&D curriculum


 What You'll Bring
   

  

* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in business, Human Resources or related field
* 10\+ years of experience in Human Resources with strong expertise in career development processes or experience in senior talent career development, and/or BCG consulting experience at Consultant /Project Leader level, ideally with people, talent, and organization experience
* Experience in managing complex stakeholder group and a strong track\-record of building deep\-lasting relationships with key stakeholders
* Experience in consulting strongly desirable
* Proficiency in managing large sets of confidential information and basic analytics
* Strong skills in Windows Office (in particular, PowerPoint and Excel) and new digital information sharing and management tools (Egnyte, Slack, etc.)


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 As a member of our Global HR team, the MD HR Executive Talent Senior Manager will liaise effectively with the senior leaders of our Specialty Businesses, BCG Centers of Expertise, regional and local HR Ops and Finance counterparts as well as internal lawyers.
   

  

 This will involve working remotely with team members, stakeholders and counterparts, located in various geographies.
   

  

 Additional info
   

  

**We Are Looking For Someone Who**
* Thrives in a fast\-paced, global, intellectually intense, and service\-oriented environment
* Is an active team player with excellent interpersonal skills, tact, a positive attitude and an ability to generate trust, influence, and build relationships with senior stakeholders
* Possesses strong organizational, operational, analytical and conceptual skills to successfully manage processes in a complex, matrixed organization
* Is a creative solution seeker and problem solver who proactively seeks to improve the experience and quality of support delivered to our stakeholders
* Has strong oral and written communication skills and the ability to adapt to various audiences and communicate effectively
* Is a self\-starter with the ability to work independently with limited supervision
* Demonstrates high integrity, ethics and respect for confidentiality and sensitivity of personal information


 Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

**Role Purpose**
 The Manager, Global Talent \& Development (T\&D) is responsible for designing, leading, and delivering enterprise\-wide talent, leadership, learning, culture, and capability initiatives. The role drives strategic people development priorities, ensures global consistency with local relevance, and partners closely with business and HR stakeholders to build future\-ready capabilities across the organization.

 Program \& Portfolio Ownership
   

  

* Own and lead one or more global Talent \& Development portfolios (e.g., Leadership, HiPo, Culture, DEI, Wellbeing, Learning Systems, People Analytics, Future Readiness, etc.).
* Define strategy, roadmap, and success criteria for assigned programs aligned with business and people priorities.
* Ensure integration of Valmet culture across all owned initiatives.


 Global Program Design \& Delivery
   

  

* Design, program\-manage, and continuously improve global development programs and interventions.
* Oversee global campaigns, learning journeys, assessments, and development tools within owned scope.


 Facilitation \& Coaching
   

  

* Facilitate and coach leaders, teams, and employees in global programs and targeted development sessions.

* Partner closely with People \& Culture (P\&C) colleagues, business leaders, and fellow T\&D Managers to ensure alignment and impact.

* Act as a Subject Matter Owner (SPOC) for designated business areas, regions, or processes.


 Analytics, ROI \& Insights
   

  

* Define and track impact, ROI, and effectiveness of owned programs using people and learning analytics.
* Use data and employee listening insights to continuously improve program design and outcomes.
* Contribute to enterprise\-level reporting and decision\-making.


 Systems, Vendors \& Governance
   

  

* Own or contribute to governance of learning systems, assessment tools, and development platforms.
* Manage vendors, budgets, and invoicing within assigned scope.
* Support global standards while enabling regional flexibility.


 Communication \& Enablement
   

  

* Lead communication and change enablement for assigned global T\&D initiatives.
* Partner on internal campaigns, eLearning support, and toolkits to drive adoption and engagement.
* Maintain clear ownership and communication with P\&C and senior stakeholders.


**Special regional focus**
 Asia Pacific Region
   

  

**Preferred Locations**
 Chennai, Pune or Mumbai

* Strong experience in global Talent \& Development, Leadership Development, Organizational Development, or Culture transformation in a complex, international organization.
* Proven ability to design, lead, and scale enterprise\-wide development initiatives across multiple countries, functions, and cultures.
* Strong facilitation and group process design skills, with the ability to lead impactful workshops, leadership sessions, and development interventions.
* Experience coaching leaders and teams, supporting leadership growth, team effectiveness, and cultural change.
* Ability to translate business strategy into capability and development solutions that build future\-ready skills.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively with senior leaders and cross\-functional teams.
* Experience working with learning ecosystems (e.g., learning platforms, digital learning journeys, assessments, leadership diagnostics, etc.).
* Data\-driven mindset with experience in people analytics, impact measurement, and program effectiveness evaluation.
* Strong project and program management skills, including managing complex initiatives with multiple stakeholders and vendors.
* Comfortable working in global and multicultural environments, with the ability to adapt approaches to different regional contexts.
* Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex concepts into clear and engaging messages.
* Curiosity and passion for continuous learning, innovation in development practices, and building inclusive and diverse leadership capabilities.


**Our Leadership Principles Guide How We Work At Valmet**
* Take Accountability – Own outcomes and deliver on commitments
* Lead with Courage – Speak up, challenge assumptions, and drive change

 KPMG Global Services (KGS) was set up in India in 2008\. It is a strategic global delivery organization, which works with more than 50 KPMG member firms to provide a progressive, scalable and customized approach to business requirements
   

  

 The KGS journey has been one of consistent growth, with a current employee count of nearly 10,000 operating from four locations in India — Bengaluru, Gurugram, Kochi, Pune and Mumbai providing a range of Advisory and Tax\-related services to member firms within the KPMG network.
   

  

 As part of KPMG in India, we were ranked among the top companies to work for in the country for four years in a row by LinkedIn, and recognized as one of the top three employers in the region for women, as well as for policies on Inclusion \& Diversity by ASSOCHAM (The Associated Chambers of Commerce \& Industry of India).
   

  

**Team Overview**

The team’s capabilities include Corporate Finance, Transaction Services, Strategy, Business Modelling, Accounting Advisory Services, Deal Advisory Research and Benchmarking.
* KPMG’s Integration \& Separation team (ISA) advises clients on executing the operational integrations of acquisitions or joint ventures, and separations of businesses, in the case of divestitures or sale. I\&S does this by taking an enterprise‑wide view of M\&A deals, across all the functions, to deliver value to our clients. In addition, team is also involved in pre\-deal Due Diligence on specific areas of business.


**Responsibilities**
 We are recruiting for Consultant in the HR M\&A team.

* Working with onshore colleagues to lead and provide support on a wide variety of M\&A projects including global programs from a people, workforce analytics and organization effectiveness perspective

* Work with project teams to analyze workforce data by applying key analytical tools to provide key insights and suggest solutions to solve complex client challenges

The role requires deep technical expertise, incident resolution ownership, and proactive system improvement in a 24/7 enterprise environment.
 



  





 Location: Technopark Phase 1, Trivandrum
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




**Infrastructure \& Systems (Windows/Linux)** 



* Manage and troubleshoot: Windows Server (2016–2025\), Active Directory, GPO; Linux servers (RHEL, Ubuntu, CentOS)
* Handle: AD replication, DNS/DHCP, OU design; Patch management, OS hardening
* Lead: Server build/migrations, upgrades, and DR planning



**Microsoft 365 / Entra ID** 



* Administer: Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive); Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)
* Manage: Identity lifecycle (JML); Conditional Access, MFA, PIM
* Troubleshoot: Mail flow, hybrid setup, federation issues



**Networking (L2/L3\)** 



* Configure \& troubleshoot: Switching (VLANs, STP, trunking); Routing (Static, OSPF, BGP basics)
* Manage: LAN/WAN connectivity; Network performance and latency issues
* Work with: MPLS, VPNs, Internet breakout



**Security \& Firewalls** 



* Configure \& manage: Firewall policies (Fortinet, Palo Alto, Cisco ASA, etc.)
* Handle: NAT, ACLs, VPN tunnels (Site\-to\-Site, SSL VPN)
* Support: Security audits, VA/PT remediation; Log analysis and incident response



**Incident \& Problem Management** 



* Act as L3 escalation point
* Perform: Root Cause Analysis (RCA); Problem management
* Ensure: SLA adherence; Minimal downtime



**Automation \& Optimization** 



* Develop scripts using: PowerShell, Bash
* Automate: User provisioning; Monitoring \& alerting
* Optimize: System performance and cost



**Documentation \& Compliance** 



* Maintain: Architecture diagrams; SOPs, runbooks
* Support: ISO 27001, SOC 2, audit readiness
* Ensure: Change management (CAB process)



  





**Technical Skills Required** 



* Core Skills
* Windows Server \+ Active Directory (Expert)
* Linux Administration (Intermediate–Advanced)
* Microsoft 365 \+ Entra ID (Expert)
* Networking fundamentals (CCNA level minimum)
* Firewall \& security concepts



  





**Tools \& Technologies** 



* Azure / AWS (basic to intermediate)
* Monitoring tools (Zabbix, SolarWinds, PRTG, etc.)
* Backup tools (Veeam, Acronis)
* SIEM (optional – Sentinel, Splunk)



  





**Scripting** 



* PowerShell (mandatory)
* Bash (preferred)



  





**Qualifications** 




 Bachelor’s degree in IT / Computer Science or equivalent
 



 Certifications (preferred):
 


* Microsoft (AZ\-104, MS\-102\)
* Cisco (CCNA/CCNP)
* Linux (RHCSA/RHCE)
* Security (Fortinet NSE, Palo Alto)



  





**Experience** 




 Overall 15\+ years of experience out of which 5–10 years experience in enterprise IT infrastructure/ Systems
 



 Experience in:
 


* Large environments (500\+ users)
* Hybrid cloud setups
* 24/7 support operations



  





**Key Competencies** 



* Strong troubleshooting \& analytical skills
* Ability to handle critical incidents under pressure
* Cross\-domain knowledge (Infra \+ Cloud \+ Network \+ Security)
* Excellent communication \& stakeholder management



  





**Work Environment** 



* 24/7 support (shift/on\-call rotation)
* Exposure to enterprise clients (US/Global)
* Participation in CAB / change governance

title: Business/HR Analyst
description:
**About The Role**
 At Loop Health, data drives everything—from how we serve employees to how we scale one of India’s most ambitious health platforms. As a
 **Business Analyst** 
 , you’ll sit at the center of decision\-making across the company.
   

  

 You’ll own business reporting end\-to\-end, partner closely with cross\-functional leaders, and help build the data foundation that powers Customer Success, Operations, Support, and Finance. This is a high\-ownership role with real impact on how Loop runs day to day.
   

  

 If you enjoy turning messy data into sharp insights, building dashboards people actually use, and asking the right questions before jumping to answers—this role is for you.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Design, track, and analyze core business metrics across Customer Success, Operations, Support, and Finance
* Define clear KPIs for ongoing and new initiatives—and build automated, self\-serve reporting around them
* Partner with business teams to break down ambiguous problem statements into structured analyses
* Own the business reporting pipeline end\-to\-end—from data validation to stakeholder\-ready insights
* Build dashboards and reports that leadership trusts and teams rely on daily
* Continuously drive automation, accuracy, and efficiency in how data is collected, analyzed, and shared


**What We’re Looking For**
* 1–3 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Analytics Consultant, or similar role in a fast\-growing tech company
* Strong intuition for business metrics and how they connect to real\-world outcomes
* Comfort working with large, messy datasets and making sense of them
* Curiosity and speed in picking up new domains, tools, and business concepts
* Hands\-on proficiency in SQL, Excel, Python, and dashboarding tools like Metabase or Tableau
* High ownership mindset—you don’t wait for instructions, you create clarity
* Willingness to do the grind, dig deep, and raise the bar every week


**What We Offer**
* Competitive salary with room to grow fast
* Fully funded medical coverage for you and your family
* Regular, high\-quality feedback—great work is noticed and rewarded
* Fun events for Loopers, friends, and family
* Learning reimbursement for books, courses, and conferences—we invest heavily in your growth
* Progressive leave policies including “Gift a Leave” and Period Leave
* A culture that genuinely prioritizes mental and physical health

title: Business Analyst
description:
*Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.*




*The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in\-vitro diagnostic products.*




*In over* 
*37 years* 
*, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over* 
*65,000 staff* 
*across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than* 
*950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies* 
*across* 
*59 countries* 
*. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.*




*In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6\.95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.*



**Job Description**

 Job Summary
   

  

 The Business Analyst will act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams. The role involves understanding business needs, translating them into clear requirements, and supporting the delivery of technology solutions that drive business value.
   

  

  

  

 ✅ Key Responsibilities
   

  

 🔹 Requirements \& Analysis
   

  

 Elicit, analyze, and document business requirements (BRD, FRD, User Stories).
   

  

 Conduct stakeholder interviews, workshops, and requirement\-gathering sessions.
   

  

 Translate business needs into functional and non\-functional requirements.
   

  

 Create process flows, use cases, wireframes, and data models.
   

  

 🔹 Stakeholder Management
   

  

 Act as a liaison between business users, product owners, developers, and QA teams.
   

  

 Manage stakeholder expectations and ensure alignment on scope and priorities.
   

  

 Facilitate discussions to resolve requirement gaps or conflicts.
   

  

 🔹 Solution Support
   

  

 Collaborate with technical teams during design and development.
   

  

 Support sprint planning, backlog refinement, and UAT activities.
   

  

 Validate implemented solutions against business requirements.
   

  

 Assist in change management and user adoption.
   

  

 🔹 Documentation \& Governance
   

  

 Maintain requirement traceability matrices (RTM).
   

  

 Ensure proper documentation and version control.
   

  

 Support compliance, audit, and governance processes where applicable.
   

  

 Required Skills \& Competencies
   

  

 🔹 Core Skills
   

  

 Strong business analysis and problem\-solving skills
   

  

 Excellent written and verbal communication
   

  

 Experience with Agile/Scrum and/or Waterfall methodologies
   

  

 Stakeholder management and facilitation skills
   

  

 🔹 Technical \& Tools
   

  

 Requirement tools (JIRA, Confluence, Azure DevOps, etc.)
   

  

 Process modeling (BPMN, Visio, Lucidchart)
   

  

 SQL basics and data analysis (preferred)
   

  

 Experience with APIs, integrations, or enterprise systems (ERP, CRM) is a plus
   

  

  

  

  

  




**Qualifications**

 🎓 Qualifications
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field
   

  

 MBA or equivalent qualification is a plus
   

  

 💼 Experience
   

  

 3–6 years of experience as a Business Analyst (adjustable)
   

  

 Experience in IT, SaaS, enterprise systems, or regulatory environments preferred

**About Sibros Technologies**
****Who We Are****
 Sibros is accelerating the future of SDV excellence with its Deep Connected Platform™ that orchestrates full vehicle software update management, vehicle analytics, and remote commands in one integrated system. Adaptable to any vehicle architecture, Sibros’ platform meets stringent safety, security, and compliance standards, propelling OEMs to innovate new connected vehicle use cases across fleet management, predictive maintenance, data monetization, and beyond.
   

  

 Learn more at www.sibros.tech.
   

  

****Our Mission****
 Our mission is to help our customers get the most value out of their connected devices.
   

  

 Follow us on
   

  

 LinkedIn \| Youtube \| Instagram
   

  

**About The Role**
 Job Title: Software Engineer \- I
   

  

 Experience: 1 \- 4 years
   

  

 One of Sibros’ core products is to offer OTA (over\-the\-air) software updates to a fleet of vehicles. We believe all the new vehicles will have some form of connectivity to the cloud in a few years. We are building a deployment engine that powers millions of vehicles with millions of software updates. This is not an easy problem to solve, especially in the automotive industry: vehicles could go offline anytime, poor network connectivity is a norm, updates need to happen only in safe circumstances… the list could go on. As part of the team, you will be tackling one of the most challenging and critical problems in the OTA domain at planet scale, untangling various race conditions and scaling issues in a large distributed system.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

* Design and implement highly scalable, reliable distributed systems to orchestrate firmware package and configuration deployments across millions of vehicles
* Build an end\-to\-end secure package distribution system leveraging the IEEE Uptane framework
* Collaborate closely with firmware engineers, frontend engineers, and product owners to deliver essential features such as deployment strategies and event\-driven notifications
* Define APIs as foundational building blocks that enable customers to automate their entire deployment workflows
* Understand vehicle\-to\-cloud communication patterns and develop efficient solutions to handle complex race conditions
* Engage directly with customers to understand real\-world pain points and iterate on product solutions


 What you should know
   

  

* 1 \- 4 years of working experience as a software engineer.
* Excellent in communication and collaboration across functional organizations.
* Excellent understanding of computer science fundamentals, data structures, and algorithms
* Experience in designing and implementing microservices in production\-grade.
* Willingness to wear multiple hats and adapt to a fast\-paced startup environment
* Proficient in writing at least one programming language (Java/ C\#/ Ruby/ Python/ Golang) in production\-grade.
* Experience in the public cloud and cloud\-native technologies. E.g., AWS, GCP, Azure.
* Experience in developing large\-scale deployment/workflow orchestration systems. (bonus)
* Good understanding of security, certificate, and encryption, and familiar with update frameworks like TUF or Uptane (bonus)


 What We Offer
   

  

* Competitive compensation package and benefits
* A dynamic work environment with a flat hierarchy and the opportunity for rapid career advancement.
* Access to continuous learning and development opportunities.
* Flexible working hours to accommodate different time zones.
* A culture that values innovation and promotes a work\-life balance.


 Equal Opportunity Employer
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.
   

  

 This job description provides a comprehensive outline designed to attract individuals experienced in inside sales and looking to advance their career in a dynamic and growing industry. Adjustments can be made based on the specific needs of your team and changes in business strategies.

**Location:** A50, Dasharathpuri, Dabri Palam Road, Bharti Refrigeration Works, 110045  
**Nearest Metro Station:** Dashrathpuri  
**Working Hours:** 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM  
**Internship Duration:** 3–6 Months  
**Mode:** On\-site

**About the Role**

We are looking for an enthusiastic and motivated **HR Intern** to support our Human Resources department in daily administrative and recruitment activities. This internship will provide hands\-on exposure to real HR operations and help build a strong foundation in HR practices.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Recruitment \& Hiring**

* Assist in posting job openings on job portals and social media
* Screen resumes and shortlist candidates
* Coordinate interview schedules
* Communicate with candidates via email/phone

**2\. Employee Documentation**

* Maintain employee records and HR databases
* Assist in preparing offer letters and onboarding documents
* Ensure proper filing of employee information

**3\. Onboarding \& Engagement**

* Support new employee onboarding process
* Help organize employee engagement activities
* Assist in attendance and leave tracking

**4\. HR Operations Support**

* Help in HR reporting and data management
* Assist in policy documentation and updates
* Provide general administrative support to HR team

**Requirements**

* Pursuing or completed graduation
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Basic knowledge of MS Office (Excel, Word)
* Willingness to learn and take initiative
* Good organizational skills

**What You’ll Gain**

* Practical exposure to recruitment \& HR operations
* Real workplace experience
* Opportunity to learn HR tools and processes
* Certificate of Internship (upon successful completion)

Job Types: Fresher, Internship  
Contract length: 6 months

Pay: ₹6,000\.00 \- ₹10,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Human Resources Intern
description:
**About the Company** 




 Zetheta Algorithms Private Limited is a FinTech start\-up which has been recently set up and is developing innovative AI tools.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are seeking a talented and motivated student intern for a Human Resources role. This is an extraordinary opportunity for a self\-driven, people\-oriented student with a passion for talent management and organizational development to support our team building efforts. You will manage the entire human resources function (other than payroll and labour compliances) with over 200\+ employees.
 



  





**About the Internship:** 




 As a Human Resources Intern, you will work on developing recruitment strategies, onboarding processes, and intern engagement initiatives. You will have the opportunity to engage in multiple mini\-projects across various HR domains. The internship is designed to provide practical exposure to startup HR functions in a FinTech environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 As part of the internship, you will work through a structured set of assignments designed to enhance your understanding of human resources principles and practices. Your primary responsibilities will include:
 



 Recruitment Support
 


* Manage with intern recruitment campaigns
* Develop job description templates
* Create candidate screening processes and screen the applicants
* Support interview scheduling and coordination
* Prepare Offer Letters and manage database of interns
* Prepare certificates required by the interns.



 Onboarding Process Development
 


* Design intern onboarding workflows
* Create orientation materials and presentations
* Develop training schedules and resources
* Build intern feedback collection mechanisms



 Intern Engagement
 


* Create engagement activities and initiatives
* Develop communication channels for interns
* Design performance recognition programs
* Build mentorship and development frameworks



 HR Documentation
 


* Develop HR policy documentation
* Create intern handbook and guides
* Design performance evaluation templates
* Build HR process documentation



 Capstone Project
 


* Complete an end\-to\-end HR project including: Recruitment strategy, Onboarding process, Engagement program, and Performance evaluation framework



  





**What You Will Learn** 



* Practical experience with start\-up HR operations
* Recruitment and selection techniques
* Onboarding and training development
* Engagement and retention strategies
* HR documentation and process development



  





**Who Should Apply?** 



* Student or fresh graduate from human resources, psychology, or related disciplines
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills
* Organized and detail\-oriented approach
* Basic understanding of HR principles
* Willingness to self\-learn and work in a fast\-paced environment



  





**Internship Details** 




 Duration: Self\-paced. Option of 15 days 1 month or 2 months or 4 months or 6 months provided.
 



 Type: Unpaid

title: Delivery Operations Team Lead
description:
**Skill required:** Talent Acquisition\- end to end \- Talent Identification  

**Designation:** Delivery Operations Team Lead  

**Qualifications:**Any Graduation
  

**Years of Experience:**7 to 11 years
  

**About Accenture**  

Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
  

**What would you do?** US Recruitment Admin Lead to oversee and manage the recruitment administration team. This role is critical in ensuring the smooth execution of recruitment operations, maintaining compliance, and driving process improvements across the hiring lifecycle. The ideal candidate will bring leadership, strategic thinking, and a deep understanding of US hiring practices. Recruitment Admin lead will be responsible for performing day to day task as per the recruitment process guidelines: 1\. Lead and mentor a team of recruitment administrators supporting US hiring operations. 2\.Oversee interview scheduling, offer management, background checks, and onboarding coordination. 3\. Ensure data accuracy and compliance within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS). Talent Acquisition \- End to End involves managing the entire recruitment process from start to finish. This includes identifying job needs, sourcing candidates, conducting interviews, and making job offers. The goal is to efficiently fill positions with the best talent. Responsibilities also include onboarding new hires and ensuring a smooth transition into the company. This role is crucial for building a strong and effective workforce. Assess current and future talent needs, identify mission\-critical workforces, understand key workforce skills and competencies, and address talent gaps.  

**What are we looking for?** Excellent communication skills, Uses professional, error\-free grammar and formatting in emails Speaks with clarity, warmth, and confidence during virtual interactions. Collaborate with recruiters, hiring managers, and HR business partners to streamline administrative processes. Monitor and report on recruitment metrics and SLAs to ensure operational efficiency. Drive continuous improvement initiatives in recruitment workflows and documentation. Ensure adherence to US labor laws, EEO guidelines, and internal compliance standards. Manage vendor relationships related to background checks, job boards, and onboarding tools. Provide training and support to new team members and stakeholders on recruitment systems and processes.
  

**Roles and Responsibilities:** •In this role you are required to do analysis and solving of moderately complex problems • May create new solutions, leveraging and, where needed, adapting existing methods and procedures • The person would require understanding of the strategic direction set by senior management as it relates to team goals • Primary upward interaction is with direct supervisor • May interact with peers and/or management levels at a client and/or within Accenture • Guidance would be provided when determining methods and procedures on new assignments • Decisions made by you will often impact the team in which they reside • Individual would manage small teams and/or work efforts (if in an individual contributor role) at a client or within Accenture • Please note that this role may require you to work in rotational shifts


  

Any Graduation

title: Mfg Asst Supervisor
description:
Overview:
* Ensuring support to manufacturing manager in meeting the production targets, SA along with optimum efficiencies.
* Co\-coordinating with manager in deciding the optimum capacity utilization across lines and SKU combinations for the shift based on the capacities and dispatch priorities \- communication the packaging leader of the plan and develop them working jointly to sustain key packaging deliverables in line with AOP.
* Ensuring minimal waste \+ rejects and maximum capacity utilization in shift.
* Ensuring smooth and efficient running of all lines and minimum downtime.
* Ensuring Zero debate BBS related best practices \& SOPs are followed by operators. No LTA/ fire incident in manufacturing.
* Why\-why analysis of all the process related issues and closing actions with Engineering within agreed timeline.
* Ensuring compliance of all the Key controls.
* Clearing AIB, safety, M\&W related audits with no NC in manufacturing.
* Ensuring all quality related parameters are met during production
* Ensuring timely information to Argo in case of potato related quality problems and Quality Dept. in case of any other quality related problems identified online and timely clearance of hold materials.
* Ensuring shop\-floor hygiene, food safety, product quality, packaging quality, TPM circles, Safety at the top during operation all the time
* Preparing the daily manpower plan for the permanent workers based on the production plan – preparing the shift roster and displaying it on the notice board.
* Preparing the manpower plan for contract workers daily balancing idle line capacity.
* Redeploying people based on competencies or gaps identified at a particular workstation to build the capability of people and line.
* Ensuring timely, accurate updating and maintenance of information related to department performance.
* Ensuring disruption free operation by addressing shop\-floor dispute of workers and don’t let such arguments to crop up as IR issues/unionized issues.
* Shop\-floor communications on various targets, opportunities area, market feedback, month’s targets, score cards etc. Motivating shop floor team, exploring R\&R sessions\& make the team participative to key agendas of plant.
* Ensure adherence to core PepsiCo processes like KP


Responsibilities:
**Safety*** Implement safety standards and drive safety culture.
* Participate in safety meetings and close the agreed recommendations within agreed timeline.
* Work with SHE pillar and safety coordinator on implementing the Safety related action points and working to ensure Zero LTA in the plant.
* Execute safety and sustainability capex and initiatives.

 **Sustainability*** Track, monitor and report sustainability KPIs \- EUR and WUR
* Drive sustainability agenda and take essential steps to achieve goals.
* Drive new sustainability project trials through continuous improvement

 **People Management*** Deployment of workmen on respective workstations as per plan
* driving the agenda for DL, developing backups on redeployment matrix to impact on manpower productivity. Regular coordination with HR on tracking unauthorized absenteeism and OT trend and ensuring effective communication to sustain good discipline.

**Production Deliverables*** Ensuring compliance to weekly/ monthly production targets as per PepsiCo quality and hygiene standards, delivering AVC over \& above AOP.
* Maximising TE/ NE , ensuring conversion efficiencies better than AOP and executing ideas on productivity.
* sharing views with sector SMEs for troubleshooting and capturing better productivity ideas implemented across other plants as a part of continuous improvement.
* Coordinating \& planning with cross functional team members to ensure seamless production.

 **Capacity Utilization*** Running the lines with best NE TE by monitoring \& reducing NE TE losses \& utilizing manpower planning in line with actual plan a capacity.

 **Waste Management*** Ensuring minimal wastage, recirculation ideas, optimum manpower utilization and operating at maximum efficiencies.
* Driving for “ZERO Loss” mantra for the lines with the help of sector team and by utilizing TPM tools \& ensuring cross functional involvement (focusing on JH culture on shop floor).

 **Planning and Reporting*** Ensuring integrity of data entry across lines, monitoring the data on shift to shift basis and reporting of the all the numbers on daily bases for the best control on the line.

 **IR Management*** Ensuring line discipline during production – OT, Absenteeism control, motivating the teams for the positive environment at the shop floor.
* Conducting 1\-1 with the operatives, conducting ZOZi sessions for the self and implementation of “Each one teach one”, “KPL” etc on the shop floor for the better engagement and building inclusive culture \& keeping the operation disruption free

 **Support to Cross function*** Enabling effective coordination with support functions \& implementation of a quality,
* hygiene, safety \& TPM culture that promotes company growth.
* Also ensuring the “Why Why Analysis” of b/d on timely manner. Need to ensure control on consumable cost.

 **SAP Management*** Batch closing and stock verification in Day store, taking care of GCS, SOX audit and KC compliances.
* Ensuring inventory management by proper transferring of FG and taking RM by proper hand shaking between the cross functional departments.

**NPD Handling*** Ensuring compliance to all NPD production, reference and Gold sample production on timely manner with AOP efficiency numbers.
* Ensuring proper feedback to R\&D to build upon the current standards.

 **Cost Management*** controlling the consumables, parts change management and developing new vendors for the reduction in consumables, better quality of parts at the engineering stores with close coordination with engineering team and engineering store person and sensitizing the shop floor team.

 **Acting as a reliever*** Relieving Shift In\-charges as and when required.

 **M\&W and other audit*** Acting as a manufacturing control owner/ representative of MNW data; quality \& safety audit.

 **New projects*** Acting as manufacturing representative for upcoming new projects.

 **Statutory Compliances*** Prepare statutory calendar and ensure implementation.
* Electricity act, The Air (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, The Legal Metrology Act, The Explosives Act, The Petroleum Act, The Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, The Factories Act,

 **Learning*** Seeking feedback from seniors and peers
* Reflecting on own competencies and possible gaps
* Setting learning goals in consultation with seniors
* Monitoring implementation of these goals
* Continuously updating knowledge from outside environment
* Develop in\-depth understanding of MIS, VMOH, MOR etc.


Qualifications:
* BE/BTech in Mechanical / Electrical / Chemical / Food Technology with minimum 6\-8 years of experience in a FMCG / Food industry desirable.
* Sound Process \& equipment knowledge
* Improvement projects experience
* Experience of working in shifts
* Knowledge of manufacturing and packaging
* Good Communication and negotiation skills

title: AVP, Learning & Development (L10)
description:
Job Description
**Job ID**
2601024
**Category**
HR
**Date posted**
04/09/2026  

  

**Role Title** **: AVP, Learning \& Development (L10\)****Company Overview**: Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a premier consumer financial services company delivering one of the industry’s most complete digitally enabled product suites. Our experience, expertise and scale encompass a broad spectrum of industries including digital, health and wellness, retail, telecommunications, home, auto, outdoors, pet and more.* We have recently been ranked \#2 among India’s Best Companies to Work for by Great Place to Work. We were among the Top 50 India’s Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All by GPTW and Top 25 among Best Workplaces in BFSI by GPTW. We have also been recognized by Ambition Box Employee Choice Awards among the Top 20 Mid\-Sized Companies, ranked \#3 among Top Rated Companies for Women, and Top\-Rated Financial Services Companies.
* We provide best\-in\-class employee benefits and programs that cater to work\-life integration and overall well\-being.
* We provide career advancement and upskilling opportunities, focusing on Advancing Diverse Talent to take up leadership roles.

**Organizational Overview**:
This role will be part of the Synchrony Asia HR/L\&D team which is dedicated to fostering a culture of continuous learning and growth within the company. We work closely with various functions and leadership teams to identify organizational leadership learning needs and provide targeted solutions that align with business goals. In a dynamic and collaborative environment, we prioritize data\-driven decisions, evaluating the effectiveness of our leadership programs to ensure we are meeting both employee and organizational needs. The L\&D team plays a key role in shaping the company’s workforce and helping employees unlock their full potential.**Role Summary/Purpose**
In this role, you will have responsibility for the design, management, delivery, and ongoing evaluation of learning programs that help our employees advance their skills and knowledge, while identifying growth gaps. You will support plans to bridge these gaps by serving as a consultant on programs and programming driven by the Learning \& Development team. You will support ongoing development in line with current organizational needs by partnering with stakeholders and HR partners across all hubs (U.S., India and Philippines), as well as anticipating future development needs across all levels of the business. The role includes an Asia regional emphasis. You will facilitate training sessions locally and partner with local learning vendors to design, develop, and implement both global and locally relevant learning programs and courses.
The role requires strategic vision, critical thinking, and innovative approaches to elevate learning programs, strengthen leadership capability, and improve measurable outcomes.**Role Expectations**
The AVP, L\&D:* Has an acute sense of organizational goals and objectives, and designs and delivers learning experiences aligned to business priorities, including priorities across our Asia hubs.
* Has a strong understanding of portfolios and sub\-processes and their learning and development requirements, with the ability to translate global learning strategy into locally effective solutions for India and Philippines audiences.
* Adopts a global One Synchrony mindset in all learning and development initiatives, rooted in strategic thinking, including needs identification, design, delivery, support, vendor partnership, and curation that results in a holistic learning framework with strong adoption and impact in Asia hubs.

**Key Responsibilities*** Develop, design, and deploy Leadership Development programs and programming to ensure employees are equipped with competencies needed to be successful at work, including leadership learning design and facilitation of leadership programs for US and Asia hub audiences.
* Serve as a key learning partner for our Asia hubs by facilitating learning sessions locally (in\-person and virtual) and ensuring a consistent, high\-quality learner experience.
* Partner with local learning vendors in Asia hubs to design, develop, and implement global learning programs (localized as needed) and hub\-specific programs/courses aligned to business and cultural context.
* Implement learning needs identification and assessment tools (surveys, focus groups/brainstorming, one\-to\-one meetings) across hubs.
* Create, maintain and report Learning Dashboards for the L\&D team and function being serviced; effectively measuring impact of all learning interventions by monitoring the success of the programs enabling employees to make the most of learning opportunities and deliver value for the business.
* Create and maintain analytic rigor for learner audience (nominations, footfall, coverage, diversity, impact) with hub\-level tracking globally.
* Measure impact and demonstrable change from learning needs identification through post\-learning outcomes; apply insights to continuously improve learning effectiveness.
* Act as a lead, facilitate programs, and engage as a producer to support program delivery as per learning plans, including end\-to\-end facilitation readiness and delivery excellence.
* Identify and embrace multiple learning modalities (coaching, job\-shadowing, workshops, classroom, online) across in\-person, virtual, and hybrid environments to meet business/individual needs, including time\-zone and learner context considerations for global hubs.
* Establish and maintain effective relationships across all levels of the organization and functions/hubs with consistent stakeholder, Workforce Planning Ops and HR partner engagement, to provide relevant learning opportunities and strengthen adoption and reinforcement in day\-to\-day work.
* Develop and drive stakeholder assessments, learning plans, and projects that assist in facilitation of strategic learning goals.
* Build strong supplier relationships and support the supplier management lifecycle in partnership with the Sourcing and Supplier Management Team, including selection, governance, and performance management to deliver best\-fit content and solutions.
* Stay abreast of developments and challenges in driving a learning culture; bring insights to the L\&D team to develop strategies and focused interventions.
* Budget management, understanding of yearly allocation, proper utilization, and accountability, including budget considerations for Asia hub delivery and vendor partnerships.

**Required Skills/Knowledge*** Bachelor’s degree with 5\+ years’ experience in learning and development, or in lieu of a degree, 7\+ years of experience in learning and development.
* Minimum 2 years of learning, facilitation, instructional design and/or program management experience within/external to Synchrony, including demonstrated experience facilitating leadership programs.
* Demonstrated experience in leadership learning design (e.g., leadership curricula, manager development, cohort\-based experiences, blended solutions).
* Strong presentation and facilitation skills (virtual and in\-person).
* Strategic thinking proficiency, with demonstrated ability to translate strategy into scalable programs and measurable outcomes across global audiences.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and effectively manage multiple priorities across global stakeholders and different time zones.
* Flexibility in work hours in support of hybrid and global environment.
* Advanced knowledge of MS Office applications, including Teams.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge*** Minimum 5\+ years demonstrated learning \& development leadership experience, including leadership program delivery and/or leadership capability building.
* Demonstrated ability to report data and analyze learning processes using reporting tools like Tableau / SAS BI (or similar) to drive improvements and recommendations.
* Ability to think and act strategically in a fast\-paced, ever\-changing environment; uses critical thinking and innovation to elevate learning outcomes.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities with little supervision in a virtual environment, while maintaining strong execution in Asia hubs.
* Strong in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Proven facilitation skills and experience delivering presentations and programs at various levels of the organization, including leadership audiences.
* Experience in project management and maintaining budgets.
* Experience in supplier management with strong communication and negotiation skills, and the ability to build strong relationships with supplier partners, including local vendor partnerships in Asia hubs.

**Eligibility criteria**
Bachelor’s degree with 5\+ years’ experience in learning and development, or in lieu of a degree, 7\+ years of experience in learning and development.**Work Timings:**This role is eligible for Enhanced Flexibility and Choice offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally) on most days. This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may vary periodically due to business needs. Given the responsibilities and programs supported, this role will also require some flexibility with work timings. When there is a training program or learning session being conducted, the incumbent would be expected to flex their schedules to be available for the entire duration of the program.
Please discuss this with the hiring manager for more details.**For Internal Applicants**:* Understand the criteria or mandatory skills required for the role, before applying.
* Inform your manager or HRM before applying for the role on Workday.
* Ensure that your professional profile is updated (fields such as education, prior experience, skills) and it is mandatory to upload your updated resume (Word or PDF format).
* Must not be any corrective action plan (First Formal/Final Formal, LPP).
* L8\+ Employees who have completed 18 months in the organization and 12 months in their current role and level are only eligible.
* L8 \+ Employees can apply.

* Engagement with stakeholders as needed to ensure up to date data is incorporated into reporting and visualisations.

* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in\-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.

* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.

* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub\-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.
